//dependencies: Intentionally empty. Everything the interface uses is bundled into dist/ by Vite, and the Electron main process imports nothing but Node built-ins and electron itself. Listing them as runtime dependencies would make electron-builder copy node_modules into the package as well, which put 33 MB of already-bundled React into app.asar.
